subject: Carr Park Renovation Funding
overview: The committee approved allocating $11,000 for geotechnical soil testing and the remaining $35,000 in the Parks and Recreation Linkage Trust Fund as contingency reserves for the Carr Park Phase II renovation project.

items.title: Carr Park Soil Borings Funding Request
items.summary: Approved $11,000 from the trust fund to conduct soil borings and utility line clearance analysis for a planned shade canopy at Carr Park.

items.title: Carr Park Project Contingency Funding
items.summary: Approved allocating the remaining trust balance of $35,000 as contingency funding to address potential utility rerouting and inspection costs during the Carr Park renovation.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from October 31, 2023.
